excerpt: We expect to continuously meet the criteria in the right column, although we cannot make guarantees about an evolving landscape with continually adaptive attackers.

locator: Table 1 / Non-novel chemical/biological weapons production / Mitigations—ambitious industry-wide recommendations
context_stem: Row: Non-novel chemical/biological weapons production; Column: Mitigations—ambitious industry-wide recommendations
excerpt: A frontier developer should make a strong argument that individual users and relatively small teams will not become significantly more likely to cause catastrophic harm via their usage of product surfaces or via theft of model weights.
paraphrase: Industry-wide recommendation: developers should argue that small teams/individual users won't gain significantly increased ability to cause catastrophic harm via product use or weight theft.

locator: Table 1 / Non-novel chemical/biological weapons production / Mitigations—ambitious industry-wide recommendations / bullet 1
excerpt: Restrictions on model behavior, and/or measures for quickly detecting and acting on Usage Policy violations, accompanied by a strong case that these measures are difficult to reliably, sustainably circumvent via jailbreaking.
paraphrase: Recommended measures include behavior restrictions and rapid detection/enforcement against Usage Policy violations, backed by a robust anti-jailbreak case.

locator: Table 1 / Non-novel chemical/biological weapons production / Mitigations—ambitious industry-wide recommendations / bullet 2
excerpt: Precautions against opportunistic theft of model weights, such as centralized controls on third-party applications and software updates.
paraphrase: Recommended measures include precautions against opportunistic weight theft, such as centralized third-party app and update controls.

excerpt: This column summarizes commitments drawn from other sections of this policy and associated artifacts. It should be read as an overview, not as indicating any separate or additional plans.
paraphrase: The middle column is a summary of commitments described elsewhere, not a source of new obligations.

locator: Table 1 / Novel chemical/biological weapons production / Capability or usage threshold
context_stem: Row: Novel chemical/biological weapons production; Column: Capability or usage threshold
excerpt: AI systems with the ability to significantly help threat actors (for example, moderately resourced expert-backed teams) create/obtain and deploy chemical and/or biological weapons with potential for catastrophic damages far beyond those of past catastrophes such as COVID-19.
paraphrase: The threshold covers AI systems that could significantly help moderately resourced expert-backed threat actors create weapons causing damage far beyond COVID-19.

locator: Table 1 / Novel chemical/biological weapons production / Mitigations—our plan as a company
context_stem: Row: Novel chemical/biological weapons production; Column: Mitigations—our plan as a company
excerpt: We will apply protections at least as strong as our ASL-3 protections (see previous row) to an expanded set of potential use cases for AI, covering the most likely vectors for this threat.
paraphrase: ASL-3-level protections will be extended to cover more use cases relevant to this expanded threat.

locator: Table 1 / Novel chemical/biological weapons production / Mitigations—our plan as a company
context_stem: Row: Novel chemical/biological weapons production; Column: Mitigations—our plan as a company
excerpt: Additionally, we will identify the most concerning specific threat pathways, create policy recommendations for early detection and response for such threats, and share this content with policymakers.
paraphrase: Anthropic will identify concerning threat pathways, create early-detection policy recommendations, and share them with policymakers.

locator: Table 1 / Novel chemical/biological weapons production / Mitigations—ambitious industry-wide recommendations
context_stem: Row: Novel chemical/biological weapons production; Column: Mitigations—ambitious industry-wide recommendations
excerpt: A frontier developer should make a strong argument that threat actors will not become significantly more likely to cause the sort of catastrophic harm discussed in the lefthand column via their usage of product surfaces or via theft of model weights.
paraphrase: Developers should argue that threat actors won't gain significantly greater catastrophic capability via product use or weight theft.

locator: Table 1 / Novel chemical/biological weapons production / Mitigations—ambitious industry-wide recommendations
context_stem: Row: Novel chemical/biological weapons production; Column: Mitigations—ambitious industry-wide recommendations
excerpt: This will likely require similar measures to those from the previous row, but to a higher standard—to the point where even well-resourced and -staffed threat actors would be unlikely to reliably jailbreak models or cause catastrophic harm via unauthorized access to or modification of models (including via stolen or modified model weights).
paraphrase: A higher standard than the prior row is needed, sufficient to resist even well-resourced threat actors from jailbreaking or causing harm via unauthorized access.

locator: Table 1 / Novel chemical/biological weapons production / Mitigations—ambitious industry-wide recommendations
context_stem: Row: Novel chemical/biological weapons production; Column: Mitigations—ambitious industry-wide recommendations
excerpt: This would likely mean security roughly in line with RAND SL4, but it depends on the capabilities of the strongest and most plausible threat actors that are not bound by a credible governance regime enforcing the recommendations for industry-wide safety outlined here.
paraphrase: This implies security around RAND SL4, contingent on the capability of the strongest unbound threat actors.

locator: Table 1 / High-stakes sabotage opportunities / Capability or usage threshold
context_stem: Row: High-stakes sabotage opportunities; Column: Capability or usage threshold
excerpt: AI systems that are highly relied on and have extensive access to sensitive assets as well as moderate capacity for autonomous, goal-directed operation and subterfuge—such that it is plausible these AI systems could (if directed toward this goal, either deliberately or inadvertently) carry out sabotage leading to irreversibly and substantially higher odds of a later global catastrophe.
paraphrase: The threshold covers highly relied-upon AI systems with sensitive access and moderate autonomous/goal-directed capacity that could plausibly cause sabotage raising odds of later global catastrophe.

locator: Table 1 / High-stakes sabotage opportunities / Capability or usage threshold
context_stem: Row: High-stakes sabotage opportunities; Column: Capability or usage threshold
excerpt: In the near term, this possibility will likely be most applicable to AI systems that are extensively used within major AI companies, with the opportunity to manipulate how their successor systems are trained and deployed as well as the evidence used to assess their safety.
paraphrase: Near-term, this applies mainly to AI systems used internally at major AI companies that could manipulate training or safety evidence of successor systems.

locator: Table 1 / High-stakes sabotage opportunities / Capability or usage threshold
context_stem: Row: High-stakes sabotage opportunities; Column: Capability or usage threshold
excerpt: Down the line, this possibility may come to apply to AI systems deployed within government and other high-stakes settings.
paraphrase: In the future, this threshold may extend to AI systems used in government and other high-stakes settings.

locator: Table 1 / High-stakes sabotage opportunities / Mitigations—our plan as a company
